capturedFor: 076-f D3 — re-observation of the two D3-affected game rows on the new terminal APK
comment: D3 replaced the whole-control opacity:0.5 collapse with a token-driven disabled
treatment (fill backgroundElement, label textSecondary, no opacity), so the two
game rows that describe a disabled-looking submit control had to be re-observed
on the new APK. Both were re-observed from their live game boards, in both
themes, by decoding the rendered screenshot and computing the WCAG 2.x contrast
ratio between the button fill and the label glyphs.

steps: Force-stop the app, cold-launch it via the per-game deep link braintraining://game/<id>.
Dismiss the intro tutorial and start the game so the live board renders.
Read the accessibility hierarchy and require the control to be present with enabled=false.
Screencap the device and decode the PNG in-process.
Classify the control's pixels by exact colour: FILL = most common colour, LABEL = most common non-fill colour.
Compute the WCAG 2.x relative-luminance contrast ratio between them.
method.stability: The LABEL pixel count is identical for a given control across themes (924 px for the Submit labels, 1655 px for Submit guess), which is expected because it is the same text at the same size; only the colours change. This is the cross-check that the classifier is picking the glyphs and not an antialiasing artefact.

supportingDeterministicCaptures.surface: Profile route disabled Buy controls (streak-buy-freeze / streak-buy-shield / streak-buy-recovery)
supportingDeterministicCaptures.comment: Same shared Button component rendered disabled, used as a deterministic second witness because the buy controls are disabled whenever the coin balance is insufficient, independent of game progression.

tokenIdentity.comment: The measured colours equal the design tokens the repair specifies, pixel for pixel, so no opacity compositing remains.
tokenIdentity.oldDefect: opacity:0.5 over the whole control produced roughly 1.63:1, below the 4.5:1 WCAG AA threshold

verdict: PASS — both D3-affected game rows now have measured, identity-verified evidence for the disabled submit control on the new APK, in both themes, at 7.25:1 (light) and 9.14:1 (dark), both above the 4.5:1 AA threshold.
